decision: Wave40 rejects fixed deployment depth as a repair: at horizon 2, current-buffer GAR normalized edit-distance improvement is 0.0276, 0.0320, and -0.0035 across seeds 0-2, while horizons 4 and 8 are negative in every seed. Test the predeclared distribution-shift hypothesis with a minimal paired seed-0 head-only adaptation. Both arms freeze the checkpoint policy and all representation/dynamics parameters, use 512 training examples, four states per example, 64 target-free current-buffer candidates, exact target-privileged edit-advantage labels, two epochs, and identical optimization. The treatment trains on states visited by the frozen GAR policy; the information-matched control trains on expert repair-trajectory states. Evaluate both target-free at candidate budget 256 for eight decisions. Replay adaptation qualifies for seed confirmation only if its current-buffer normalized edit-distance improvement is positive and exceeds the teacher-state control by at least 0.05, without higher invalid-action or loop rate. If both arms remain non-positive, reject head-only state-distribution adaptation and isolate representation aliasing versus candidate-support limits before further training. These are oracle-supervised training diagnostics, not action-free learning claims.
